notes: Eight full order-to-handoff cycles timed by Dana Ellis with a phone stopwatch across the July 28 and 29 morning peaks -- four cycles each morning, orders picked at random from the sampled stream. Elements are the SIPOC steps inside the charter boundary; SIPOC steps 5 and 6 (call the name, hand the drink over) are timed as one element because the call and the hand are one continuous act at the pickup counter. Element medians thread to the process map's step times (0.8 / 4.5 / 2.0 / 0.6 / 0.5 min, totalling the charter's 8.4). Cycle 6 is the July 28 8:12 class-break rush; the engine flags its queue time as a high outlier and it stays in the record, flagged, never dropped. Eight cycles is below the tool's 10-cycle guidance -- the per-element note says so; spread is read as rough.
